## 2026-10-03 — daily-rabbit-hole: the first Ethereum contract failed
Discovery: the earliest known smart-contract deployment on Ethereum mainnet (block 46,402, 2015-08-07 04:42:15 UTC, deployer 0xa1e4380a3b1f749673e270229993ee55f35663b4 = thanateros.eth / Anthony Eufemio, later Digix/DigixDAO co-founder) ran out of its 24,000-gas budget before code deposit — tx 0x6c929e1c3d860ee225d7f3a7addf9e3f740603d243260536dfa2f3cf02b51de4. Verified live via public mainnet RPC today: address 0x9a049f5d18c239efaa258af9f3e7002949a977a0 returns eth_getCode 0x (empty); tx fields (from/to:null/gas 0x5dc0/value 0/block 0xb542/41-byte input) and block timestamp all match the cartoonitunes/awesome-ethereum-proofs (ethereumhistory.com) record. First executable contract followed at block 48,643 (~10.6h later), then Greeter/PrimeChecker/Coin/ponsis/chain letters; first lottery 0x7af6af3d4491a161670837d0737bada43ffbb992 (code = exactly 1,475 bytes, verified); first messaging contract 0x3a2c6e618b72f2047f5be10570582d41840b8e78 (1,574 bytes code, verified). Seen-list updated (3 entries). Report delivered in final message.

### Correction (late RPC handoff, ~10:42 CDT) — first-contract receipt landed after close-out
The stuck eth_getTransactionReceipt call completed after the report went out: contractAddress 0x9a049f5d18c239efaa258af9f3e7002949a977a0, gasUsed 0x5dc0 (24,000 = the ENTIRE gas budget consumed), status 0x0 (failed). This upgrades "ran out of gas before code deposit" from repo-reported to onchain-confirmed: the deployment tx itself is recorded FAILED with all 24,000 gas burned. Also re-confirms block 46,402 ts 2015-08-07 04:42:15 UTC.
